reviews.review:
I was optimistic at first, hearing alot of people give this game high credits, BUT This has to be one of the most over-rated piles of ♥♥♥♥ ive ever seen in my life, i don't give a ♥♥♥♥ how old this game is or what kind of GW taint licker still plays this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ and actually calls it good, its ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ god awful. (multiplayer is somewhat alright, if you don't mind tryhards who'll target you every breathing second because you're low level)

From the mediocre cut scenes that make the characters looks like they all have a 40 foot pole shoved up their asses so far that you can see the ♥♥♥♥ on their teeth, to the horrible story-line which is absolutely awful, bad writing, plot line is garbage, and the orks are literally just used as constant stop gaps between every cutscene, so that way this pile of unwanted ideas can actually count as a video game, and not some half assed attempt at a 40k animation.
literally all of the areas are as empty as the brains of the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ idiots who say this game is as good as Dawn of war. there are literally only orks,( and yes i know chaos is a thing later on in the story), with a few people scattered around ON A ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ FORGE WORLD! you'd think with an entire planets worth of military personnel, fortified defences, titan manufactorums, munition plants, ship yards, ETC, that there would be more than 2 damn guardsmen per every 20 miles in game. Furthermore, WHERE THE ♥♥♥ ARE ALL THE ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TECHPRIESTS????? for being on a damn forge world, there isnt a mechanicus member in sight, not even a damn servitor,and us being space marines getting sent in to protect a singular titan?? the hell is that? theres literally like 10 titans on the damn planet, but we only need to protect one? (and ill add on the fact that before you find the titan itself, you destroy another titans main battery gun, by DROPPING IT????) wtf is this load of Tech Heresy? where are all of the mechanicus forces meant to protect their very ideals and beliefs? why is every inch of all the factories completely empty? not even dead maintenace workers or dead servitors, just some dead guardsmen constantly thrown all over the place everywhere (to the point i now understand why the nightlords adorned themselves in dead bodies. they make good decorations instead of living useless piles of ♥♥♥♥). 

literally all the game is, is charge forward, get caught on the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ ass terrain, cant move, ork hoard charges your way, Ai teammates are braindead retarded and dont know how to use the very bolters they almost died with trying to get through scout training, teammate runs unto the hoard with melee, gets slapped around worse than an Italian wife, both teammates ♥♥♥♥ off to the other ends of the map, they both wander off during ork hoard, orks immediately de- agro, orks immediately Re- Agro only onto you,  cant heal because stuck on a chunk of concrete that was never in the way beforehand, Get utterly dog piled and molested by orks, repeat. i bought this pile of shat on G2A for 3$, and im glad i did, this game is not worth the money steam says it is. dont buy this pile of ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.

I love this game, but what the hell are they trying to pull, marking the price up from $20 to $60 on an old ass game?

Listen, Games Workshop - or whoever was backing this idea - we know that you love money, but ffs, this is just scummy.
very fun, and I really enjoyed the multiplayer. would say it was worth the price.
a new update? anniversary edition? maybe i CAN get all the achievements!
